purpose: Validate promoted production assets against adjacent and dependent scenes, persistent character/world state, timeline, spatial memory, narrative consequences and cross-scene asset lineage before universe-level reuse.
core_principle: A scene can pass local QA and still break the story; CSD-033 validates continuity across scene boundaries.
hard_gates: Target asset must be a CSD-032 promoted immutable asset version.
All referenced scene versions must be canonical and non-superseded.
Character identity and immutable visual identity must remain stable.
Character emotional/behavioral state must be explainable from prior canonical events.
Character knowledge cannot contain information not legitimately acquired.
Relationship changes must have causal provenance.
Timeline must not move backward or introduce impossible overlap.
Spatial state must be reconstructable from canonical scene history.
Persistent world changes must agree with CSD-026 environmental memory.
Costume and prop transitions must have valid predecessor state.
Branch-dependent assets cannot leak across inactive narrative branches.
Asset lineage must resolve back to its CSD-030 master and CSD-031 execution attempt.
Cross-scene validation cannot mutate historical scene masters.

promotion_policy.PASS: Asset may be reused across eligible scenes.
promotion_policy.PASS_WITH_WARNINGS: Asset may proceed only with explicit warning annotations.
promotion_policy.REWORK_REQUIRED: Asset remains promoted but is blocked from dependent-scene reuse until revalidated.
promotion_policy.CONTINUITY_BLOCKED: Asset cannot enter downstream scene production.
promotion_policy.QUARANTINED: Asset lineage or canonical state must be reconciled before reuse.
